attributes.name: ypy-native-component
attributes.description: Asks the native app shell to render the named native component for this element. The element stays valid HTML and is the fallback in a browser. The name must be one the installed app build lists in its capabilities.

attributes.name: ypy-native-props
attributes.description: The properties of the native component: one JSON object, at most 2 KiB, data only.

attributes.name: ypy-native-hide
attributes.description: Hides the element in the app (the web header that a native bar replaces). It also becomes `inert`, so it leaves the accessibility tree and the tab order.

attributes.name: ypy-native-only
attributes.description: Shows the element only in the app. In a browser it is hidden and `inert`.

attributes.name: ypy-native-click
attributes.description: On the element itself: an `action` message from its native component clicks the element.

events.name: ypy:native:event
events.description: Fires on the element of a native component when the shell sends an event for it. Cancel it to stop the default, which is a click for `ypy-native-click` and an `action` message.

events.name: ypy:native:before:visit
events.description: Fires on the source element before a visit is handed to the shell. Cancel it to keep the navigation in the page.

events.name: ypy:native:navigate
events.description: Asks the page to navigate its main content. The shell takes it as a visit; a browser swaps the page. The server sends it with `YPY-Trigger`.

config.name: native.path
config.description: The URL of the path configuration document, or `false` to not load it. The shell reads the same document.

config.name: native.web
config.description: Outside the app, open the routes whose path configuration says `context: modal` as a layer (needs `ypy-layers`).

headers.name: YPY-Native
headers.description: Sent on every same-origin YPY request of a native app: the platform, the bridge version and the native components the installed build knows. Decide on `caps`, not on the version, and send `Vary: YPY-Native, User-Agent` when the HTML depends on it.
